scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @studyroom/api" "npm run dev -w @studyroom/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @studyroom/shared && npm run build -w @studyroom/api && npm run build -w @studyroom/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @studyroom/shared && npm run build -w @studyroom/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @studyroom/shared && npm run build -w @studyroom/web
scripts.render:start: npm run db:migrate && npm run start
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @studyroom/shared && npm run typecheck -w @studyroom/api && npm run typecheck -w @studyroom/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @studyroom/api && npm run test -w @studyroom/web
